paper_title: Morphosyntactic probing of multilingual BERT models
caption: The effect of context masking perturbations by tag. Error bars indicate the standard deviation.
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the effect of context masking perturbations by tag on the performance of various language models. The horizontal axis represents different categories, including “gender”, “number”, “tense”, “case”, and “tag,” while the vertical axis, labeled “effect,” displays the performance score, ranging from approximately 1 to 20. The scale appears to be linear, with tick labels spaced uniformly every 2 units. Each bar represents one of the models: mBERT-L2 (blue), XLM-L2 (dark blue), mBERT-R2 (green), XLM-R2 (olive), mBERT-B2 (salmon), and XLM-B2 (maroon); the approximate heights of the bars are 10.2, 11.4, 6.1, 8.7, 9.3, and 5.1 respectively, with standard deviations indicated by error bars fluctuating between 1 and 3 units above and below each value.  The bars are sorted in ascending order of height, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond their standard deviation error bars.
